findings.summary: `self._items.remove(session)` is O(n) on every logout, which could add up with many sessions.
`del self._items[i]` is O(n) per removal, so a large purge is O(n²); rebuilding the list in one pass or using an insertion-ordered dict keyed by token would be O(n).
No tests cover `logout_handler` or `purge_job`; the reviewer calls them thin wrappers and low risk.
